stemMd: Which statement cannot be true in any permitted order?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Electrical and Drive must occupy consecutive positions, in either order.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Electrical and Drive must not occupy consecutive positions.

explanationMd:
Test whether each proposed statement can be added consistently to the rules. "Cooling must be in position 3." is incompatible with every permitted order. The alternative statements each have a complete valid example, given in their feedback. To check impossibility, enumerate placements for the most restricted item or block, then remove every case breaking a rule.

Complete permitted orders (each arrow advances one position):
- Alignment → Cooling → Electrical → Drive → Balance
- Drive → Cooling → Electrical → Alignment → Balance
- Electrical → Alignment → Balance → Cooling → Drive
- Electrical → Drive → Balance → Cooling → Alignment
